name: doccanon
description: Verified, branch-aware project memory that stops coding agents from trusting stale documentation.

interface.shortDescription: Verified project memory for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: DocCanon keeps coding agents from trusting stale repository documentation. It checks branch-relative freshness before work, routes minimal canonical context, maps every changed implementation file to feature and cross-cutting owners, blocks unaccounted changes, migrates scattered brownfield knowledge with evidence receipts, and automatically captures auditable development and evidence-backed release history.
defaultPrompt: Set up DocCanon for this project.
Migrate this project's scattered documentation into DocCanon.
Check whether this project's canonical docs are stale.
